topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the session's key learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in tumor initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal fitness and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin determine susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influence and inflammatory promotion in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and supportive microenvironments are required to promote tumor development and sustain established tumors.

topics.label: Technological methods for investigating tumor biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes experimental sequencing and spatial omics technologies used to analyze tumor cell states and microenvironments.

topics.label: Multi-factorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the interplay of mutational accumulation, epigenetic plasticity, cell of origin, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the next session on cancer therapy.
